rejected.title: Declarative programming for the physical world
rejected.reason: Excluded: the assigned Show HN excerpt asks what declarative programming for the physical world might feel like, but identifies no specific existing task, repeated chore, or requested service. A student workflow and buyer would have to be invented, so there is not enough demand evidence to assess a proposal.

steps.message: Assessed the single sealed discussion assignment and declined to propose a post because its excerpt gives a broad concept rather than a concrete chore or service request.
